name: ibis Styles Bandung Grand Central
short_description: A 240-room ibis Styles opposite the Gedung Sate landmark in central Bandung, with the brand's all-inclusive rate and design-led interiors.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bandung Grand Central (Accor code 9339) is a 240-room, 3-star design-led hotel located opposite the Gedung Sate landmark, one of Bandung's most iconic buildings and the governor's office of West Java. The hotel carries the ibis Styles signature: an all-inclusive rate covering breakfast and unlimited Wi-Fi, alongside locally inspired interiors. Its central location places it near Bandung's government district, shopping areas, and culinary destinations. For ALL elite members, standard ibis-level programme benefits apply. The 240-room count makes it one of the larger ibis Styles properties in Indonesia, and the Gedung Sate location is a genuine differentiator among Bandung Accor hotels.
